evidence: Trimethylaluminum /H20849TMA/H20850, Al/H20849CH3/H208503/H20852and titanium isopropoxide /H20849TTIP/H20850,T i/H20849OC3H7/H208504/H20852were used as Al and Ti precursors, respectively, with oxygen plasma as the reactant gas. TMA and TTIP were maintained at 30 and 50°C, supplied in Ar gas at a flow rate of 100 sccm using a bubbler system. Ar and O gas were used as the purge and reactant gases at respective flow rates of 150 and 50 sccm.
